machineNarrationReview.transcript: A software provider claims 85% invoice automation, does that mean 85% savings, not necessarily. Price the exceptions. Example of 1000 invoices. Manual processing costs $1.20 each monthly baseline $1,200. AI software costs $400, 150 exceptions need review at $3 each of $450. 20 post acceptance errors cost $10 each to fix $200. Total AI workflow costs $1,050. The difference is $150 per month before setup. Quality still needs independent testing, measure accepted results, exception rate, reworked and customer impact. Prism Bay AI helps operators build practical AI business systems.
